items.title: Hadestown (Broadway): Equity Chorus Call, Dancers
items.bring: Headshot and resume stapled together, dance clothes, flat dance shoes or sneakers, Equity card. Come warmed up; choreography is taught.
items.notes: Afternoon all-genders dance call for future replacements at $2,799 a week; the notice doesn't say non-Equity dancers will be seen, so a non-member only gets in if the producer chooses to see extras at the end of the day.

items.title: Ain't Too Proud: Equity Chorus Call, Dancers
items.notes: All-genders Equity dance call listed on BroadwayWorld (which relays Equity's casting board); a matching stage manager notice points to the John W. Engeman Theater production, and the full notice could not be opened to confirm non-Equity policy.

items.title: Happy Feet (developmental workshop): Equity Chorus Call, Dancers
items.org: Dancing With Penguins LLC (producer Dori Berinstein; casting The Telsey Office)
items.bring: A brief pop/rock song, headshot and resume stapled together, Equity card.
items.notes: Michael Arden directs and Ayodele Casel co-choreographs, and they want tap dancers and strong movers, but the workshop runs Feb 15 to Mar 13, 2027, before you turns 18, so this one is a show to watch, not attend.

items.title: 9 to 5: Equity Chorus Call, Dancers
items.where: Chicago, IL (Equity Chicago Member Center, 557 W Randolph St)
items.bring: Dance clothes, sheet music in your key, headshot and resume, Equity card.
items.notes: Today at 1:30 PM, callbacks Oct 16, run Jan to Mar 2027 at a $920 weekly minimum.

items.title: That Tap Dance Show: Rhythm Tap Dancers
items.org: Masterworks Theater Company and Measuring Time Dance Collective
items.where: New York, NY (Tap Dance Central, 154 Christopher St)
items.bring: Hard copy headshot and resume, tap shoes, warm-up clothes. Combinations are taught.
items.notes: Non-union Off-Broadway tap show at Theater 555 paying $215 a performance; auditions Oct 20 at noon, callbacks Oct 22, rehearsals from Nov 10 and a run to Jan 3, 2027, which collides with his school year.

items.title: Paul Taylor Dance Company: Male Dancer Audition
items.where: New York, NY (Taylor Dance East, 551 Grand St, top floor)
items.bring: Not specified; sign up through the audition form on the page and plan to stay all day.
items.notes: Two male dancers strong in modern, contemporary and partnering, in person only, 10 AM start with same-day callbacks, $1,038.75 a week for about 40 to 44 weeks with full benefits.

items.title: Robin Becker Dance: Male-Presenting Dancers for Into Sunlight
items.bring: Online application first; if selected, a printed headshot and resume.
items.notes: Apply by Oct 18 at noon, invited dancers audition Oct 25, then weeknight NYC rehearsals Oct 28 to Jan 15 and one show Jan 16, 2027, so it only works for someone living in New York.

items.title: staibdance: 2-3 Male Dancers for a New Work
items.where: Atlanta, GA (video first, callbacks in person)
items.bring: Headshot, resume, and a 2-5 minute video of improvisation plus learned or self-made phrase work.
items.notes: Form due Oct 21 at 5 PM ET (the company page misprints the year as 2027), callbacks Nov 6-7 in Atlanta, paid rehearsals Jan to May and Aug to Oct 2027 at $17-$22 an hour; the age line says 25+ is encouraged, not required.

items.title: Midwest College & Company Audition
items.notes: Group audition with masterclasses and a Q&A in front of college and company reps for a $100 fee; Dance/USA still lists it but the Zeffy ticket page says sales are closed, so confirm before planning anything.

items.title: Orlando Ballet Trainee (Merit Scholarship) Video Audition
items.bring: Video through the Jackrabbit submission link on the page.
items.notes: Scholarship-covered trainee track that feeds Orlando Ballet's company, video submissions accepted until Dec 31; the current page gives no age range (an older Orlando Ballet page said 16-21) and the work is classical, so your ballet has to carry it.

items.title: Ain't Too Proud: Male Ensemble (video submissions)
items.bring: Headshot, resume, a 32-bar Motown-style song video, and a dance or movement reel.
items.notes: Non-union Florida dinner-theatre contract at $500 a week plus housing, rehearsals from Dec 27, 2026 and a run to Feb 21, 2027; the ensemble breakdown is specific to the Temptations story, so it likely isn't your track.

items.title: Damn Yankees Auditions
items.bring: 16 bars with sheet music, resume and headshot if you have them, dance clothes (no sandals).
items.notes: Community theatre and every role is unpaid, but the audition has a dance portion and it's a Florida stage credit about 90 minutes from Orlando.

items.title: Big Fish Auditions
items.notes: Same community theatre as Damn Yankees, listed on BroadwayWorld's non-Equity board; only the title and dates were seen, so open the listing for roles and whether it is paid.

items.title: SETC Professional Auditions (Spring Convention 2027)
items.age_rule: Must be 18 before screening registration closes; high school students are not eligible
items.bring: Online screening submission ($40) through Acceptd; dancer-only applicants go through this professional screening.
items.notes: The biggest Southeast cattle call for summer stock and theme-park contracts, but he misses the 2027 cycle on age and school status, so the 2028 cycle (screening fall 2027) is his first real shot.

items.title: SETC Summer Outdoor Theatre Auditions
items.age_rule: Must be 18 before the registration deadline; high school students are not eligible
items.bring: Dance reel of 3 minutes or less, dance attire and shoes, and a monologue or song (strongly recommended); $55 fee.
items.notes: Hiring call for outdoor summer dramas, registration Nov 30, 2026 to Jan 15, 2027; you are under 18 and still in high school, so this is a 2028 target.

items.title: Ballet Hispanico School: 2027 Audition Tour (La Academia, Professional Studies)
items.where: New York, NY, tour cities TBA, or video
items.age_rule: La Academia is for dancers ages 7-23
items.bring: Register or submit a digital audition through DanceApply.
items.notes: The 2027 audition tour and NYC auditions start Jan 9, 2027; this is the training route into Ballet Hispanico's world, since the company itself auditions by invitation and no BHdos call is posted.

items.title: Radio City Christmas Spectacular: Rockettes and Ensemble Dancers (2027 auditions)
items.where: New York, NY (Radio City Music Hall)
items.age_rule: Ensemble Dancers must be 18 by the first day of rehearsals in October; Rockettes must be 18 by the first day of the contract
items.bring: Online registration with a digital headshot and resume; time slots are emailed 72 hours ahead. Under-18s need a parent or guardian with them.
items.notes: 2026 registration is closed and the page takes sign-ups for 2027 alerts; the open call has been in April, and with a mid-October birthday you may land just after the October rehearsal start, so ask before booking a flight.

items.title: Cirque du Soleil: Dancer Casting Profile
items.bring: Up to 10 minutes of unedited video: a 1-minute spoken intro, then 1-minute solo clips of your main style, improvisation, and any other skills.
items.notes: No auditions are scheduled right now, but dancers can apply anytime through the casting portal, and hip hop, contemporary, tap and jazz are all listed categories (portal is down Oct 17-19, Oct 24-26 and Oct 31-Nov 2 for maintenance).

items.title: Disney Theatrical (The Lion King and other Broadway/tour shows): Equity Dance Calls
items.age_rule: The Aug 2026 Lion King call described dancers as late teens to early 30s
items.bring: Flat jazz shoes or bare feet, a song with sheet music, headshot and resume stapled together.
items.notes: Disney posts replacement dance calls through Equity (the last Lion King Broadway and tour calls were Aug 10 and 12, 2026), so watch the Equity listings on BroadwayWorld or Playbill for the next one.

items.title: Prather Productions: Headshot, Resume and Reel Submissions
items.org: Prather Productions (national tours, Broadway Palm, Dutch Apple)
items.bring: Headshot, resume and reels by email to the artistic producers (Brian Enzman for Broadway Palm in Fort Myers, Lauren Sobon for Dutch Apple and touring).
items.notes: Prather produces national tours plus two dinner theatres and keeps submissions for future casting; specific calls get posted on outside casting sites.

items.title: Broadway Palm Dinner Theatre: General Main Stage Submissions
items.where: video (theatre is in Fort Myers, FL)
items.bring: Headshot, resume and video and/or audio audition, emailed to the casting contacts on the page.
items.notes: Florida dinner theatre that says video auditions are always welcome; the only dated notice right now is a child role, so a general submission is the move.

items.title: Orlando Shakes: Equity Principal and Non-Union General Call
items.bring: Headshot and resume for the actor database; musical candidates have prepared 16 bars in past calls.
items.notes: The 26/27 auditions are done; the theatre holds an Equity call and a Non-Union General Call every spring (March to April), posted on its page, socials and auditions newsletter.

items.title: Actors' Playhouse: Mainstage Season Auditions (AEA and Non-Union)
items.org: Actors' Playhouse at the Miracle Theatre
items.notes: 2026-27 season auditions (late May 2026) are over and the season includes Come From Away and Rock of Ages; the next AEA and non-union calls should post on this page for 2027-28.

items.title: Theatre Tampa Bay Unified Auditions
items.org: Theatre Tampa Bay (Jobsite Theater and other Tampa companies)
items.where: Tampa, FL (New Tampa Performing Arts Center in 2026)
items.notes: Annual Tampa-area unified audition where local companies cast their seasons (June 6 in 2026, with video accepted that day); no 2027 date is posted yet.

items.title: Florida Musical Theatre Intensive
items.org: Dr. Phillips Center for the Performing Arts
items.notes: Two-week pre-pro program that ended with West Side Story in Steinmetz Hall in June 2026; 2027 dates aren't posted, but as a graduating senior you fit the grade rule if it runs again.

items.title: Philadanco D/2 Apprentice Company Auditions
items.bring: $15 cash fee at the door (2026 call).
items.notes: The last D/2 audition was Jan 11, 2026; no 2027 date is posted yet, so watch this page in December and January.

items.title: Dallas Black Dance Theatre: Encore! Company Auditions
items.bring: Headshot, dance resume, dance photos and a dance reel.
items.notes: The 2026/27 Encore! cycle closed Feb 13, 2026 with invite-only auditions in March; expect the next cycle on the same page early in 2027, questions to auditions@dbdt.com.

items.title: Visceral Dance Chicago: Video-Only Submissions
items.bring: Headshot, resume and a Vimeo or YouTube link with an intro, ballet center work and contemporary improvisation.
items.notes: The page still takes video-only submissions for the 2026/27 season with no closing date; the in-person cycle has run in late winter.

items.title: Hubbard Street Dance Chicago: Company Auditions
items.notes: 2026/27 company auditions are over; join the email list on this page to hear about the next ones.

items.title: Martha Graham Dance Company: Company Auditions
items.bring: A 3-5 minute video reel with the registration form.
items.notes: The last cycle took videos until Apr 27, 2026 for June auditions, AGMA contracts from $760 a week; Graham 2 recruits from the Graham School, not open calls.

items.title: Pilobolus: Future Dancer Openings
items.bring: For general inquiries: cover letter, resume and three references to jobs@pilobolus.org.
items.notes: No open audition right now; the last dancer call was a video round due Feb 23, 2026, so expect the next one on this page in winter.

items.title: Garth Fagan Dance: Future Dancer Submissions
items.bring: Resume and dance footage (including a barefoot section) emailed to the artistic director, subject "FUTURE DANCER OPPORTUNITY - [Name]".
items.notes: No open positions now and upcoming auditions are full, but materials are reviewed on a rolling basis; joining means moving to Rochester for about two years.

items.title: Lula Washington Dance Theatre: Year-Round Company Auditions
items.notes: Auditions happen inside Tuesday company class, 11 AM to 12:30 PM, but call (323) 292-5852 first because class stops when the company tours; their Young Adult Ensemble (ages 16-23) auditions separately in the fall.

items.title: MOMIX: Dancer Auditions
items.notes: No 2026-27 call was found and the official page would not load; past calls required 18+ and US work eligibility.

items.title: The Ailey School: 2027 Audition Tour (Ailey II pipeline)
items.org: The Ailey School / Alvin Ailey Dance Foundation
items.where: New York, NY and tour cities TBA
items.notes: Ailey II has no public audition and mostly draws from The Ailey School; the school says in-person dates for the 2027 tour will be announced in October, with a $30 fee for Professional Division programs.
